ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (cream/white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous cream-colored regions localized in the mid-distal sections of both lobes, bordered by solid black pigment at the peduncle junction and along the entirety of the trailing edges. High-frequency dark pixel speckling (mottling) is concentrated at the transition zones between light and dark pigments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude irregular undulations; distal tips exhibit high-relief, jagged serrations caused by calcified clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges and distal tips, transitioning to a linear-to-concave sweep toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast white/tan pixels (barnacle colonies) located on the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented dark linear streaks crossing the cream-colored pigmentation on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle encrustations on the lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'peppered' distribution of dark micro-pixel clusters isolated within the interior of the primary cream-colored zones.
